platform: Headless Nuxt 3 storefront (Centra commerce backend per payload fields centraProduct/centraVariant; Storyblok content; Cloudinary images at assets.paulsmith.com)
source_used: robots.txt -> /api/sitemaps/uk.xml (3,423 product URLs of 4,662) -> 120 evenly-sampled /uk/<slug> PDP HTML pages -> inline __NUXT_DATA__ (pinia.ProductStore.entity: items[] with ean/sku/stock/quantity, price, images, attributes) + JSON-LD ProductGroup/BreadcrumbList (currency, condition, availability cross-check). No _payload.json fetched (robots disallows /*.json$).
problems: Market fixed to UK storefront: all prices GBP, availability is UK stock.
sale_price 0%: none of the 120 sampled products were discounted (priceBeforeDiscount == price); logic maps priceBeforeDiscount->price, price->sale_price when reduced.
mpn left null: no explicit MPN field exposed (variant sku could serve as brand MPN but not asserted).
weight 0%: PDP entity carries no weight; weight only appears on recommendation-tile products, not the PDP itself.

brand null on 6 items (collab/homeware products with brandName null in both Nuxt and JSON-LD); brand values are sub-brands as given: {'Paul Smith': 348, 'PS Paul Smith': 252, 'Paul Smith Junior': 39, None: 6, 'Baroque Rocks': 1, 'Castore + Paul Smith': 16, 'Paul Smith Loves Barbour': 12}.
category_path null on 78 items (categoryName empty and no BreadcrumbList on those PDPs).
Nuxt entity.available is false even when items have stock 'yes' + quantity>0; availability taken from per-item stock (0 mismatches vs JSON-LD per-variant availability).
Variant SKU differs between sources: Nuxt item sku (e.g. M1A-0TIE-A40338-966CM) vs JSON-LD variant sku (M1A-0TIE-A40338-6CM); Nuxt used for item_id/sku.
JSON-LD is no longer thin (full ProductGroup with hasVariant offers) but lacks GTIN; GTIN (EAN-13) comes only from Nuxt payload.
robots.txt disallows */product, */category, /*.json$; only sitemap + PDP HTML used. No bot-wall: 123/123 HTTP 200.
